title: incident: friend_request to an offline/stale-DID recipient is recorded as queued, not 'dispatched successfully'
description: June 9 friending incident (ea-claude-130): mail was queued on the relay to a stale DID no channel claimed, the sender was told 'dispatched successfully', and the message orphaned silently until manual purge. spec-097 (delivery receipts) is the fix: the relay's mailbox_send_ok now carries recipient_live, and every --deliver path records an outbox ledger entry so a stuck-at-queued send is self-diagnosing from the sender's CLI. This fixture replays the incident sequence outbound: a friend_request sent through the production deliver path against a relay reporting recipient_live=false must land in outbox.json with recipient_live=false (the loud 'Queued — NOT connected' state), with the envelope.sent flight-recorder entry.

source.note: identities and bodies are synthetic stand-ins; the relay's recipient_live=false ack reproduces the incident's 'queued to a DID no channel claims' state
